x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.description: This fix script changes the UI Formatter for Conflict checking on a Change Request. It updates the macro to the latest version that can cater for the two modes of conflict execution. One which uses Progress workers and the new and improved version which uses Flow; this new macro checks the system property "change.conflict.useprogressworker" and then renders the corresponding macro according to its setting.
x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.name: Update Change Conflicts Formatter
